description: Dated changes to Google Business Profile, Google Maps and local Search from the Maps Agent changelog, newest first, each with its date, what changed, the source to open and our story when we wrote one. Good for 'what did Google change in Business Profiles since November 1'. Pass since (YYYY-MM-DD) for changes on or after a day.

since.description: Only changes on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. '2026-11-01'. Omit for the whole changelog.

name: get_changes

date.description: The day of the change, YYYY-MM-DD.

sources.description: The outside pages the entry cites.

story.description: Our article about the change, when there is one.

text.description: What changed, with its source, as the changelog writes it (markdown).

terms.description: The terms this answer is given under: quote with a link to the page; a copy of the base needs an agreement.

updated.description: The changelog page's own last-updated day.

title: What Google changed
